title: 第1632章 雅雅的高傲第1631章 剑术切磋
content_zh:
同岁年纪，换做寻常贵族子弟，早已沉溺享乐、根基虚浮，连握剑的定力都无。可这两个女娃，凭着日复一日枯坐练剑，硬生生磨出这般纯粹剑意，同辈相较，简直天壤之别。
格瑞拉特也微微颔首，目光郑重：
“孤山流的锐，秋水派的沉，小小年纪，竟都摸到了流派真意。假以时日，又是两位坐镇一方的剑道高手。”
战场中心，缠斗已然白热化。
波丽儿久攻不破，心头好胜心彻底燃起，身法骤然再快三分，剑招愈发刁钻凌厉，虚招层出不穷，试图打乱灰水心的沉稳节奏。
灰水心面色依旧平静无波，不见急躁，脚下步伐纹丝不乱。
忽然！
抓住波丽儿一次虚招收尾的细微破绽！
灰水心眼神一凝，沉喝一声，手中木剑骤然提速！
一刀直劈而下，势大力沉！
波丽儿来不及完全回防，仓促横剑格挡！
“嘭！！！”
巨力相撞！
波丽儿整个人被震得连连后退三步，虎口发麻，手臂微微震颤，手中木剑险些脱手。
而灰水心稳稳立在原地，身姿挺拔，纹丝不动。
一招定势。
高下，立判。
但她没有趁势追击，收剑垂落，气息平稳，淡淡看着对面喘息稍促的波丽儿。
“你急了。”
简简单单三个字，点破胜负关键。

波丽儿抿紧嘴唇，眼底满是不甘，却无从辩驳。
她确实急了。
数年执念压身，太想赢回当年的平手，太想坐稳同辈第一的位置，反倒乱了剑心，露出破绽。
但。
只是如此吗？
就在波丽儿喘息的时候，灰水心却隐隐觉得腋下有些酸痛。
注意力集中过去。
却发现，自己的腋下，不知道何时，已然受伤。
对方明明没有命中自己...
不。
不对。
对方方才的攻击，每一次角度，都有讲究，不知不觉之中，放大了自己挥剑对身体的伤害，并且借助剐蹭，将这种伤害内外贯通。
自己的确在明面的招式上赢了对方。可却在交锋之中，先受了伤。
可...
如果这不是一次技术的切磋，而是死斗呢？
最先倒下的，恐怕就是自己了。
所以。
content_en:
At the same age, if he were an ordinary noble child, he would have been addicted to pleasure, his foundation would be frivolous, and he would not even have the concentration to hold a sword. But these two girls, relying on sitting and practicing swords day after day, have mastered such pure swordsmanship. Compared with their peers, they are simply worlds apart.
Graylat also nodded slightly and looked solemnly:
"The sharpness of Gushan Ryu and the shenness of Qiushui sect. At such a young age, they have actually grasped the true meaning of the sect. As time goes by, there are two masters of swordsmanship on one side."
In the center of the battlefield, the fight was already heating up.
Bo Lier couldn't attack for a long time, her competitive spirit was completely aroused in her heart, her body skills suddenly became three points faster, her sword moves became more tricky and sharp, and there were endless feints, trying to disrupt Hui Shuixin's calm rhythm.
Hui Shuixin's face remained calm and calm, showing no signs of impatience, and her steps were unruffled.
suddenly!
Seize the tiny flaw in the end of a false move by Paulier!
Hui Shuixin's eyes narrowed, and he shouted loudly, and the wooden sword in his hand suddenly accelerated!
The sword struck straight down with great force!
Porrier didn't have time to completely return to defense, so she hurriedly blocked with her sword horizontally!
"Bang!!!"
A huge collision!
Bollie was so shocked that she took three steps back. Her mouth was numb, her arms were trembling slightly, and she almost lost her hand with the wooden sword in her hand.
But Hui Shuixin stood firmly on the spot, with a tall and straight posture, motionless.
One move sets the trend.
High or low, make a judgment.
But she did not take advantage of the situation to pursue her. She sheathed her sword and lowered it, breathing calmly, and looked at Paulier who was panting slightly across from her.
"You're in a hurry."
Three simple words reveal the key to victory or defeat.
Paulier pursed her lips, her eyes filled with unwillingness, but unable to argue.
She was really anxious.
After several years of obsession, I wanted too much to win back the tie of the past, and wanted to be the number one among my peers. Instead, I messed up the sword's heart and exposed its flaws.
but.
Is that all?
While Bo Lier was panting, Hui Shuixin felt a slight soreness in her armpits.
Focus on the past.
However, he discovered that his armpit had been injured at some point.
The other party obviously didn't hit me...
No.
wrong.
Every angle of the opponent's attack just now was carefully chosen. Unknowingly, it amplified the damage caused to the body by swinging the sword, and with the help of scratches, this damage was penetrated internally and externally.
He did win over the other party in terms of explicit moves. But in the confrontation, he was injured first.
Can...
What if this is not a technical competition, but a fight to the death?
The first one to fall may be himself.
so.
